title: Techdirt analyzes Amazon's new encryption method and points out a concrete limitation
content_md:
Techdirt analyzes Amazon's new encryption method and points out a concrete limitation: server-side encryption does not protect against certain threats.

via Mastodon http://www.techdirt.com/2026/09/21/cold-take-amazons-new-encryption-method-still-doesnt-deliver-real-privacy/
